item.title: I Wanted My Home To Smell Like Christmas, Without The Toxic Fragrances. This Switch Changed Everything.
item.description: There's always a moment each December when the season officially enters your home. For some, it's the first candle flickering while Mariah Carey warms up in the background. For others, it's that cloud of pine needles that follows you inside after wrestling the tree through the doorway. For me, it's always been the cleaning.

item.title: Gen Z Is Romanticizing The 2010s. Can You Blame Us?
item.description: Gen Z has built an identity around mocking millennial culture: the side parts, the Harry Potter tattoos, the pumpkin spice, the motivational wall art. Fine. As a fellow Zoomer, I get it. But what’s ironic is that those same accounts keep romanticizing the exact era millennials came of age in – especially the early 2010s.
